conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I requested a credit limit increase last week, and I haven’t heard back. What’s the hold-up?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I apologize for the delay, ma’am. Can you provide your card number so I can check the request status?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s ending in seven eight six four. I need this sorted soon.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you. Your request is under review. I’ll expedite it and confirm the new limit by tomorrow.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Tomorrow? Can’t you do it now? I’m planning a big purchase!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand. I’ve prioritized it, and you’ll get an update by end of day. Is that okay?
